name: VerticalResponse
line: Email marketing campaigns, newsletters and automated subscriber series.

free.text: 60 days, no card; 300 contacts and 4,000 emails/month

cells.newsletters: Yes, for contacts who opted in
cells.api: Yes, API access by request; no SMTP documented

subs.math: 1,000 contacts × 4 campaigns = 4,000 emails. The trial caps lists at 300 contacts, so a paid Basic plan is needed. Assumes 1,000 billed contacts, including the owner.
5,000 contacts × 4 campaigns = 20,000 emails. Basic covers 2,501–5,000 billed contacts, including the owner. Before tax.
10,000 contacts × 4 campaigns = 40,000 emails. Basic covers 5,001–10,000 billed contacts, including the owner. Before tax.
50,000 contacts × 4 campaigns = 200,000 emails. A quote is required above 40,000 contacts, with no public total.
